subject: Billing unit alignment for hybrid streaming + long-context
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa@brightretail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Question on how long-context + streaming charges are metered

Hey Sergio —

Quick background: our recommendation engine at BrightRetail keeps a ~6k token product prefix in memory and we stream short, interactive summaries back to customers (average 120 tokens per response). We use streaming to render partial results in the UI, and we also sometimes send the full context back to the model for a final pass.

Two specific asks before we finalize our procurement:
1) How does Redwood account for the long prefix that’s effectively reused across many calls? Are those tokens billed every request, or is there KV/prefix reuse crediting?
2) For streaming endpoints, how granular is metering? If we send a 120-token response streamed in three chunks, how is that rounded or bucketed on the invoice?

We need concrete examples (sample invoice math) because our finance team wants to map projected monthly spend for different activity bands. We’re also hoping to discuss a packaging option — our traffic profile is extremely prefix-heavy and fairly consistent, so a blended unit model or committed discount could make sense.

Attaching a tiny usage sample (billing_examples.xlsx). Can you loop in pricing/ops and let us know next steps?

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Director, Product — BrightRetail

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@brightretail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on how long-context + streaming charges are metered

Lisa — thanks for the clear note and the sample file. Quick answers up front, then a proposed pilot/discount plan and a sample calc below.

Short answers:
- Prefix / long-context: Redwood charges based on tokens processed by the model (input + output). However, our runtime supports KV cache / prefix reuse which reduces the amount of bytes re-encoded on the GPU; that reduces latency/cost at the infra layer but does not automatically retroactively zero your billing for the original prefix tokenization. In practice that means repeated reuse of an identical cached prefix will only bill the incremental tokens that are actually sent to the model after cache hit.
- Streaming: metering is per token emitted. We do not round up to large slabs by default; billing is recorded in 1-token granularity in our backend. That said, for streaming endpoints we apply a small per-request floor of 15 tokens to cover microcalls (this is only relevant for ultra-short responses). We do not split billing into fixed 100-token buckets unless negotiated.

Sample math (from your attached sample):
- Initial ingest of 6k-token prefix (first-time encode): billed as ~6,000 input tokens on the first request that establishes the cache.
- Subsequent requests that hit the KV cache and only send a 120-token response: billed as ~120 output tokens (plus negligible input delta) — so essentially ~120 tokens per call.
- Streaming in 3 chunks does not multiply charges: total emitted tokens are what matter (sum of chunks = 120 in your example) and that's what gets counted.

Proposal (to align incentives and keep you predictable):
- Pilot: 3-month pilot with a blended prefix allowance — we’ll give BrightRetail 1,000,000 "prefix-token" credits per month (these apply to the first-time encodes of long contexts, not to regular output tokens).
- Discount: if you commit to a 12-month consumption band (min $7.5k/month), we can offer a 30% discount on output tokens and absorb 50% of the first-time prefix ingestion cost beyond the monthly credit.
- Invoice detail: we’ll provide line-level token breakdown (input vs output vs prefix-credits used) and a CSV export for your finance team.

Next steps I propose: Vanessa will scope a pilot agreement and Karthik can confirm the discount tier math. If that sounds OK Lisa, can you confirm your baseline monthly query count (I used 150k calls/month in the sample calc attached)?

Attaching the sample calc and the short playbook I referenced (proration_playbook.pdf).

Thanks — looping in Vanessa and Karthik to finalize pricing.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Lisa Chen <lisa@brightretail.com>

Date: 2026-10-08T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Question on how long-context + streaming charges are metered

Sergio —

This is helpful, thanks. Couple of clarifying bullets so we can sign off internally:
- Can you show the sample invoice for three scenarios: 50k/mo, 150k/mo, and 500k/mo calls with our 6k prefix? Please include the one-time ingest billing for the prefix and the ongoing per-call output charges under both your standard per-token rate and the proposed blended discount.
- On the prefix credits: do those reset monthly or carry over?
- On the 30% discount: does that apply to both input and output tokens or output only?

We can probably pilot for 3 months and then commit if the math checks out. Trevor wants clear line items — he also asked whether audit logs will show cache hits vs misses (we need that for our internal chargeback).

If you can get a short invoice sample and the deal sketch by end of week that would be excellent.

—Lisa

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Lisa Chen <lisa@brightretail.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Question on how long-context + streaming charges are metered — sample calc & ask

Karthik / Vanessa — forwarding BrightRetail thread. Lisa asked for explicit scenario invoices for 50k / 150k / 500k calls per month with the 6k prefix. I drafted the attached spreadsheet and a short sketch of the pilot (see billing_examples.xlsx and proration_playbook.pdf). Key assumptions used in the calc:
- Standard list rate: $0.0008 per token (input+output)
- Blended output discount: 30% off output tokens only (per Lisa's ask)
- Prefix credit: 1,000,000 prefix-token credits/month (non-cumulative)
- First-time prefix ingest is charged at list rate; we’ll absorb 50% of that cost above the monthly credits during pilot.

Please confirm the discount applicability (input vs output) and whether the prefix credits should roll over or reset monthly. Once you OK I’ll share a formal pilot sketch + HubSpot deal line items.

On audit logs: we can expose cache hit/miss counts in the console export — Vanessa can include that in the pilot SOW.

Thanks,
Sergio
